description: Poll a watch's event log with watch_id and secret, paging by the returned cursors. Nothing between polls is lost.

secret.description: The one-time bearer secret returned by x402_watch_create.

since.description: Endpoint-event cursor: the `next_cursor` from a previous poll. Omit for the first poll.

watch_since.description: Lifecycle-event cursor: the `watch_events_cursor` from a previous poll. Omit for the first poll.

name: x402_watch_events
title: x402 Trust watch: poll event log
